mansion.boss7.yamijin: Yamijin: Hold on now. Aren't you here for your friends, not me, nya?
{player}: Shut up! You're the one who took them, you jerk!
mansion.boss7.rage: I won't forgive you. You, of all people, I'll never forgive! How dare you do this, you jerk! I'm gonna smash you straight into hell right now!
Yamijin: Now, now. If I'm gone, things will only get more dangerous. Well then, good-byeee! Kyeeheeheeheehee, hee-hoo, heeeee!
mansion.boss7.escaped: {player}: Hey, wait! Daaamn it, Yamijin got away again!
mansion.boss7.companions: Without thinking, {player} ran straight to the friends, and didn't notice that something was off about them.
{player}: I came to save you! I missed you so much!
But the words that came back from the friends were more than enough to break {player}'s heart.
mansion.boss7.strangers: Friend 1: Who is this person, I wonder?
Friend 2: Don't ask me. I have no idea.
Friend 3: I've never seen a weirdo like this either.
Friend 2: Hey, maybe this is the monster Lord Yamijin was talking about?
mansion.boss7.forgotten: {player}: N-no way... You don't remember me?
Friend 3: Huh? Remember? I don't even know who you are.
Friend 2: Yeah. Have we met somewhere?
Friend 1: Hmm. So it's a monster, basically?
{player}: Wait a minute. Are you serious?!
Friend 2: Serious? Are you an idiot or something?
Friend 3: Anyway, we don't know you. We're Lord Yamijin's loyal servants, you know!
mansion.boss7.attack: Friend 1: Anyway, let's hurry up and smash this thing. Lord Yamijin might praise us.
Friend 3: All right. Let's play with it a little.
Friend 2: Yeah. I kind of like this sort of thing. Hee hee hee.
mansion.boss7.cannot: I can't... I can't do it... I can't cut down my friends...
Even while being beaten, {player} could not strike back at the friends. And all the while, the former friends, controlled like puppets, kept hurting their own dear friend.
With every new wound on the outside, {player}'s heart was wounded more deeply too.
In despair, pain and sorrow, {player} could only think of the friends, and keep getting hurt.
mansion.boss7.shadow: Surrounded by the friends, {player} saw a single huge shadow.
It was a shadow that looked strangely familiar.
Yes, wasn't that the Grand Cruiser?
It was the Grand Cruiser, no doubt about it.
It had the same size and the same shape as before, but {player} did not miss the thin cords attached to it.
Fighting through the pain, {player} leaped high and, in midair, used the Light Shard from the merchant. Turns out {player} had kept it hidden somewhere other than the usual bag!
mansion.boss7.throw: {player} took a fresh grip on the Long Sword and hurled it with full force at one of the cords coming out of the Grand Cruiser.
mansion.boss7.cut: The Long Sword struck one of the three cords dead on, and sliced it clean through.
mansion.boss7.siren: Instantly, a horrible siren blared from the Grand Cruiser, and its connection was lost.
mansion.boss7.awake: Friend 3: I'm really sorry. Yamijin caught us, and this thing was controlling us. What an idiot I was.
And the other two are still out of control.
{player}: Right. I have to cut the other two cords.
Friend 3: Yeah. But now the Grand Cruiser is onto us, so I think it'd be faster to wreck the whole thing.
I'll do what I can to hold those two back. You destroy the Grand Cruiser.
Friend 3: This Grand Cruiser is bound to have some new tricks. Be careful.
mansion.boss7.collapsed: The Grand Cruiser crumbled to pieces.
mansion.boss7.hold_on: There stood the three friends, back to their old selves, looking at {player}.
mansion.boss7.thanks: Friend 2: I'm so sorry. We were being controlled, and we did such awful things
Friend 1: I'm really sorry. It's our fault, isn't it?
Friend 3: Yeah, totally. If only we'd been tougher
The one to blame is Yamijin.
I'll beat Yamijin for sure. I'll make absolutely, positively sure this never happens again.
{player}: Come on. Let's go home. There's a Warp Panel, too.
